name: catalog_records
description: One entry of a catalog: its values keyed by field identifier, including the base price of each MONEY field, its availability and its position.
lifecycle: Created and updated one at a time with the observed version; value, availability, price and position changes bump it. Deleted at runtime with its overrides, promotions and join rows, only while no other record references it.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the record (tenant key).
Catalog the record belongs to; immutable.
Sort key in the catalog's stored order, spaced so a move usually changes one row; ties order by id.
Whether the record is available; views hide unavailable records unless they show them as unavailable.

Validated JSON object from field UUID to value: trimmed text, canonical decimal strings, booleans, local dates and times, sorted weekdays, choice identifiers, media and record UUIDs, and base prices as integer minor units (ADR-0032). At most 16 KiB as serialized by the API.
Membership that made the last change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A record belongs to a catalog of the same company, which cannot be deleted while it has records.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, created_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The creator is a membership of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, updated_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The last updater is a membership of the same company.
Values are a JSON object with a storage backstop above the API's 16 KiB limit.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_records_catalog_position_idx ON public.catalog_records USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, "position", id)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a catalog's records in stored order with keyset cursors.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_records_company_id_id_key ON public.catalog_records USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that prices, record links and references target.
